name: Chick-fil-A Grilled Nuggets (8 or 12 count)
whyItWorks: Bite-sized boneless chicken breast grilled with a mild herb seasoning rather than deep-fried in peanut oil with heavy wheat batter. Delivers 25g pure protein, 1g fat, zero dairy, and zero insoluble fiber.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order standard 8 or 12 count grilled nuggets. Request no dipping sauce or dip lightly in honey or yellow mustard rather than garlic-rich CFA sauce or spicy sriracha.
